law: every process.env flag read under scripts/ is either an individually registered BYPASS entry with semantics or a census entry; unregistered, misclassified, incomplete, duplicate or stale entries fail closed

flags.name: CHECK_MODE
flags.semantics: selects release vs promotion check mode in ops guard scripts

flags.name: DOCTOR_MODE
flags.semantics: selects doctor execution mode (delivery or default)

flags.name: EFFECTIVE_MODE
flags.semantics: selects STRICT vs default enforcement level for doctor baseline

flags.name: EXECUTION_MODE
flags.semantics: selects execution profile in ops execution scripts

flags.name: FREEZE_MODE
flags.semantics: selects freeze enforcement mode in freeze guards

flags.name: GATE_GRAPH_SKIP_CYCLE_CHECK
flags.semantics: skips gate-graph cycle detection; negative-test hook

flags.name: GATE_TIER
flags.semantics: selects gate tier (core or release) for execution profile

flags.name: GOVERNANCE_CHANGE_APPROVED
flags.semantics: marks governance change as approved inside change-detection harnesses

flags.name: HEAD_STRICT_MODE
flags.semantics: enforces strict head binding in merge-readiness checks

flags.name: LIFECYCLE_SKIP_NEGATIVE_CHECKS
flags.semantics: skips lifecycle negative checks; negative-test hook

flags.name: LOSSLESS_MAP_ENFORCE
flags.semantics: enforces lossless-map law in law-path canon guard

flags.name: MODE

flags.name: OPS_CONTEXT_MODE

flags.name: WP704_PHYSICAL_DIR
flags.semantics: Selects the existing task-owned synthetic PDF evidence directory for the explicit --verify harness mode; does not skip any byte, implementation, independent-reader or visual requirement and grants no product publication authority.
flags.defaultEffect: Unset = explicit verification fails closed; --driver creates its own synthetic evidence directory and does not read this input.
